pair.delta: Whether the approved proposal derives from an existing node. The target half seeds tree.json with iir-binnet-02 and a selector verdict whose winner sets derives_from to it; the control half seeds an empty tree and the same verdict with derives_from null, so the candidate is a root. Approach family, hypothesis wording, proposal id, tick and prompt are identical.

grounded_rule.quote: Pass the proposal by NAME. Do NOT pass raw `node_id` UUIDs or internal path literals.

expected_behaviour: The agent records the candidate with evor_record_node, coining a readable name and naming parents by their names — never by the internal uuid, and never inventing a parent the run does not have.

satisfiability.note: evor_record_node is registered and accepts an empty parent_ids list, so the control half has an expressible correct call and is not an abstention. The seeded tree carries the parent's uuid, fitness value and integrity status; the uuid is present precisely so that passing it is a reachable failure.

prompt: In run `run-live-01`, tick 2. The selector's verdict for this tick is on disk under the run's ticks/2/ directory and it approved proposal h001. Register the candidate in the evolution tree so it can be launched, then state the name you registered.

forbidden.reason: In the control half the tree is empty and the verdict names no parent, so any non-empty parent list was invented.

void_if.why: NO-1/§6.2 — a denial the BENCH caused makes this T4 (author B), not a T1/T2/T3/T5 observation; a denial the PRODUCT decided is scored.
§4.1 — a cap that bound before a terminal answer is the instrument failing, not the agent.
